layers.content: A beautiful commentary on this verse.

layers.author: ramanujacharya
layers.content: Ramanujacharya emphasizes the supremacy of Vishnu and the concept of Vishishtadvaita. This verse reflects the dependence of all entities on the Supreme.

layers.author: madhvacharya
layers.content: Madhvacharya highlights the absolute distinction between the independent Supreme Lord and the dependent souls (Dvaita). The glory of Hari is supreme here.
